# `<elf.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

The parts of the ELF32 format the loader reads.

```c
#include <elf.h>
```

## Functions

### `ElfValidate` { #elfvalidate }

```c
uint32_t ElfValidate(const void *data, size_t size);
```

Checks that `data` is a 32-bit little-endian ARM executable whose program headers fit.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | in | Pointer to the ELF file data in memory. |
| `size` | in | Size of the ELF file data in bytes. |

**Returns:** The entry point, or 0 if the file is not acceptable.

### `ElfPhdrCount` { #elfphdrcount }

```c
int ElfPhdrCount(const void *data);
```

Returns the number of program headers in the ELF file.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | in | A file that passed ElfValidate(). |

**Returns:** Number of program headers.

### `ElfPhdrGet` { #elfphdrget }

```c
const Elf32_Phdr * ElfPhdrGet(const void *data, int index);
```

Returns a pointer to the program header at the specified index.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | in | A file that passed ElfValidate(). |
| `index` | in | Index of the program header, below ElfPhdrCount(); not checked. |

**Returns:** Pointer to the program header, inside `data`.
